_charlesabate_: On the way to R-C9, Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Night raid. Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate helped stack spare sandbags at R-C9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning. Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 619. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Rumour reached R-C9 that the war would be over by spring. Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate has heard it before. So has everyone.

Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Oskar "Ash" Kvasnicka, badly wounded. Orders came through: Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a cracked shaving mirror.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-C9 and grazed Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Casimir Jcsv of the Hegemony (@jcsv2305). A letter came for Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Bastian "Ghost" Charlesabate pinned it to the dugout wall.
Bastian's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
alexandernymannn: Konrad Alexandernym took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Konrad Alexandernym and Yann Ethan tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. Mail came up the line with a letter for Konrad Alexandernym. Konrad Alexandernym read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Orders came through: Konrad Alexandernym is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

Wiring party. Konrad Alexandernym held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at V-F11, and everyone came back. Konrad Alexandernym watched the enemy lines change the guard at V-F11 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Casimir Shermantank was gravely wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Konrad Alexandernym. Konrad Alexandernym read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Konrad Alexandernym checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Konrad Alexandernym. Konrad Alexandernym read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Konrad Alexandernym threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Karel Hier was down and screaming for a medic. (@winters_ist_hier) The Concord raiders came over at V-F11 in the middle of the night. Konrad Alexandernym met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Severin Houtarou of the Concord (@nguyen_houtarou).
Leopold Alexandernym put a rosary of rough beads beside the bunk. Someone who had known Konrad Alexandernym helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Leopold Alexandernym heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold Alexandernym. Leopold Alexandernym read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Leopold let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Emil Shermantank was badly wounded. The letter for Leopold ended with 'come home soon'. Leopold read the last line more than the rest.
bryce.150: Nobody saw Roland Bryce arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in N-F8, and a quiet stretcher bearer under it. Grey Mill is lost. Roland Bryce heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
At the Brickworks, Bram Toaster of the Hegemony and Roland Bryce of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Fog hid the far end of N-F8. Roland Bryce kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
Roland Bryce remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Florian Wman wrote a letter for Roland Bryce's mother, because Roland could not find the words. Roland signed it.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Roland Bryce's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
Roland Bryce stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of N-F8, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Roland listened to a corporal tell the same story for the fourth time. The ending changed again.
dr_doom12367: Casimir Doom walked into S-C14 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Casimir Doom stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A patient at the aid post asked Casimir Doom for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Casimir Doom got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 719. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Casimir Doom read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Casimir Doom traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Shell splinters hit Casimir Doom in the back and legs at S-C14. The bearers carried him face down on the stretcher.
Casimir Doom drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Casimir Doom survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at S-C14, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
The patient has added a stove and three chairs to the kitchen drawing. Casimir Doom asks about each detail while changing the dressing.
The blast lifted Casimir Doom off his feet at S-C14. He came round with a bloody nose and an empty rifle and went back to work.
Three days with a bandage, and Casimir is back at S-C14. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
el.heffy000: Silas Heffy joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.

Silas Heffy was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-R11. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ulrich "Lucky" Krokous of the Hegemony (@krokous21). News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-R11 with the rations. Silas Heffy ate while listening to the revised orders.

Silas Heffy took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-R11, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Cyril Ofsmth of the Hegemony (@cantthink_ofsmth). Silas Heffy was killed outright at S-R11, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Cyril Ofsmth of the Hegemony (@cantthink_ofsmth).

Florian Heffy arrived carrying the family name of Silas Heffy. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Heffy is number 853 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Florian Heffy watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A round went through the rim of Florian Heffy's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Roland "Lucky" Huncho of the Hegemony (@llsj_9huncho).
Florian Heffy's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Florian Heffy reached up to fix a sandbag at S-R11 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Roland "Lucky" Huncho of the Hegemony (@llsj_9huncho). Florian Heffy fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Nils Hellcat was grazed trying to cross it.

Florian Heffy was hit in the hip at S-R11. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Cyril Ofsmth of the Hegemony (@cantthink_ofsmth). Florian Heffy was killed on watch at S-R11. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Cyril Ofsmth of the Hegemony (@cantthink_ofsmth).
The House of Heffy sent Ulrich "Doc" Heffy after Florian Heffy. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Machine-gun fire swept S-R11. Ulrich "Doc" Heffy took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Silas "Mole" Darian of the Hegemony (@darian_d_16).
Ulrich "Doc" Heffy spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
The stretcher Ulrich lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Ulrich is back at S-R11, and someone else is lying in that dent now.
fenley_sam: Gideon Sam took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

An empty jam tin became Gideon Sam's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. Gideon Sam reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Gideon Sam fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Karel Jokinen, grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Gideon Sam looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them. A letter from home found Gideon Sam before the night shift. Gideon Sam folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon Sam was hit in the hip at S-S16. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). A letter from home found Gideon Sam before the night shift. Gideon Sam folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Gideon Sam answered to number 582. Grey Mill is lost. Gideon Sam heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

No bed for Gideon Sam yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. A letter from home found Gideon Sam before the night shift. Gideon Sam folded it small and kept it close.

The stretcher Gideon Sam lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Gideon Sam is back at S-S16, and someone else is lying in that dent now. A letter from home found Gideon Sam before the night shift. Gideon Sam folded it small and kept it close.

A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Gustav Foad's name scratched on it. Gideon Sam kicked it back. It did not come again. A letter from home found Gideon Sam before the night shift. Gideon Sam folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon Sam lay in the ruins of the Bone Quarry from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory. A letter from home found Gideon Sam before the night shift. Gideon Sam folded it small and kept it close.

Gideon Sam fired at a movement across the wire at S-S16. The man went down: Ulrich "Lucky" Robertoneill, grazed. There was a letter for Gideon Sam and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not. The new duty roster listed Gideon Sam as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

The men at S-S16 heard Gideon Sam call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420). Gideon Sam was hit at S-S16 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420).
Bastian Sam took the same post at S-S16 where Gideon Sam stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Bastian sorted the squad's letters by size and then by smell. The mail sergeant was not amused. The letter for Bastian had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Bastian dried it by the stove, page by page.
greedndreadnought34: Cyril Greedndreadn found a place in U-F6 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.

A patient apologized for bleeding on Cyril Greedndreadn's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached U-F6 with the rations. Cyril Greedndreadn ate while listening to the revised orders.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Cyril Greedndreadn fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Cyril Greedndreadn cut Ulrich Cylone's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Cyril Greedndreadn agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
Thunder all night. Cyril Greedndreadn flinched at every crack. The old hands said that is how you spot the new ones. By morning, they were flinching too.
Cyril Greedndreadn (Concord) and Nils Noraajs (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Bone Quarry for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
The artist tried again while Cyril Greedndreadn read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
Cyril traded a button for a pinch of tea. By the end of the week, the button had come back, and so had the tea.
hecktic_1: Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic left a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain behind in Stoneyford and came up the line with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts. The men noticed at once that he never takes off his scarf. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic asked to leave the sappers and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic and Bastian "Mud" Bnfts made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. A letter from home reached Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic before dusk. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either. A letter from home reached Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic before dusk. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet struck Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic below the ribs at N-F16. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. A letter from home reached Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic before dusk. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic read it twice and slept a little easier.

The medics would not give up on Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to N-F16 today. A letter from home reached Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic before dusk. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic read it twice and slept a little easier.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic was hit hard in the fight at N-F16 before anyone could fire. The raider was Quentin Llibrecommel of the Hegemony. Raider: Quentin Llibrecommel of the Hegemony (@llibrecommellair). Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic read it while the kettle boiled.

Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter for Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic came all the way from home in nine days. Severin "Rabbit" Hecktic counted them on the envelope.

Severin saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Severin Senicfilms, was badly wounded. Severin got a letter in a child's handwriting. Every sentence started with 'Please' and ended with 'Come back.' Severin had to go and stand outside for a minute.
ieiseog: Tobias Ieiseog found a place in P-F4 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Tobias Ieiseog wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Ulrich Redner of the Concord and Tobias Ieiseog of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Brickworks for a week. Both trenches keep score.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Tobias Ieiseog waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
A splinter opened Tobias Ieiseog's cheek at P-F4. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold.
Tobias Ieiseog returned to P-F4 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
The raid was quick, the way back was not. Tobias Ieiseog snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Tobias Ieiseog free.
Tobias Ieiseog rejoined the squad at P-F4. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Tobias boiled coffee in a bucket and strained it through a sock. Nobody asked which sock.
kg1912ss: On Day 9, Bastian "Ghost" Kgss arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss left the work of a rifleman to become a sniper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going.

An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Bastian "Ghost" Kgss was waiting. Dietrich Johnmetheny was grazed. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss wrote down the news without trying to explain it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Ghost" Kgss. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A shell hit the latrine at S-C15. Nobody was hurt. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss says it was the best day of the war. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Ghost" Kgss. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss is number 717 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Bastian "Ghost" Kgss fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Casimir Cbeattie, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

Bastian "Ghost" Kgss saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Edmund Johnmetheny, was badly wounded. A shell burst over S-C15 and threw Bastian "Ghost" Kgss into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post.

The medics cleaned Bastian "Ghost" Kgss's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-C15. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Ghost" Kgss. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bastian "Ghost" Kgss saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-C15 and fired once. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Ghost" Kgss. Bastian "Ghost" Kgss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Bastian "Ghost" Kgss and Zeno "Ghost" Ybarry argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Bastian "Ghost" Kgss lay in the ruins of Grey Mill from dawn to dusk. He did not fire once. That is also a kind of victory.

A bullet hit Bastian in the neck at S-C15. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Henrik Small of the Hegemony (@ner_small). The bearers reached Bastian at S-C15 too late. One shot, and it was over.
Leopold Kgss took the same post at S-C15 where Bastian "Ghost" Kgss stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
luke._lillie: Roland Lillie came up the line with a lucky button and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
A bullet grazed Roland's ribs at W-F12. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Quentin Oconnor of the Concord (@patrick.james.oconnor).
matthew.ordaz12: Bram Ordaz came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Bram Ordaz dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it. Victory at Grey Mill. Bram Ordaz let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Bram Ordaz borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Bram Ordaz aimed just below it. Emil Carcinogenet was badly wounded.
Bram Ordaz counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Konrad Music was grazed.
Bram Ordaz and Quentin Oorah share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Bram Ordaz was waiting. Otto Sebastian was badly wounded.

Bram Ordaz wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Bram Ordaz used it. Lucien "Brick" Rykaczewski was grazed. A trench mortar bomb landed in the next section of trench. The blast caught Bram Ordaz at T-F8 and the bearers came at a run. No bed for Bram Ordaz. A medic cut his sleeve away, bandaged the wound, and moved on to the next stretcher.
The medics called Bram 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Bram is back on the line.
metal_head2704: Severin "Smokes" Head walked into N-F15 on Day 11 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into N-F15. Severin "Smokes" Head has learned to walk bent double.
Severin "Smokes" Head offered a spare button for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
A crow sat on the parapet above Severin "Smokes" Head all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Severin "Smokes" Head received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Severin "Smokes" Head was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Severin "Smokes" Head laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Severin "Smokes" Head added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
A bullet passed so close to Severin at N-F15 that it burned his neck. The sergeant told him to count that as a haircut. Shot by Ulrich "Saint" Txh of the Hegemony (@txh.__c).
nathan_hill2308: Lucien Hill was a coal miner in Brennmoor until the posters went up. He came to R-C11 with a child's drawing of a horse, and within a day the whole squad knew that he keeps feeding the rats.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Lucien Hill wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The men at R-C11 heard Lucien Hill call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd). Lucien Hill was hit at R-C11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Henrik Sergiootd of the Hegemony (@sergiootd).

The House of Hill sent another. Tobias Hill, brother of Lucien Hill, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Tobias Hill answered to number 606. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Tobias Hill read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bullet went through Tobias Hill's sleeve at R-C11 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Emil "Lucky" Macwigger of the Hegemony (@macwigger2214).
Three days with a bandage, and Tobias Hill is back at R-C11. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
A round went through the rim of Tobias Hill's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Tobias Hill is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Tobias Hill was hit twice at R-C11, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Hugo Faulerhund of the Hegemony (@faulerhund1215). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Tobias Hill fell at R-C11 and never moved again. Shot by Hugo Faulerhund of the Hegemony (@faulerhund1215).
Emil "Rabbit" Hill arrived carrying the family name of Tobias Hill. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Emil "Rabbit" Hill fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.

A bullet nicked Emil's boot at R-C11. The heel is gone. So is a little skin. Shot by Albin Mcplate of the Hegemony (@kellen_mcplate). The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Emil waited for that to change. When it did, Ulrich Internetmang was grazed.
otto_hofmann_: "You're late," said the corporal when Dietrich Hofmann arrived on Day 11. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." Victory at Grey Mill. Dietrich Hofmann let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Dietrich Hofmann had just lit a cigarette at P-F2 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Ulrich Maloy of the Concord (@sc_maloy).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Dietrich Hofmann is whole again, or near enough for the line.
The cook's fire went out. Dietrich Hofmann relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool.
Dietrich Hofmann wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

The men at P-F2 heard Dietrich Hofmann call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp of the Concord (@speckyjp). A single shot at P-F2. Dietrich Hofmann sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp of the Concord (@speckyjp).
Anselm "Ghost" Hofmann joined P-F2 under the shadow of Dietrich Hofmann's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Anselm "Ghost" Hofmann and Dietrich "Shadow" Sealy made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Anselm kept Jakub Jnk awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Ghost could have walked there blind.
rybilton: Florian "Ash" Rybilton reached P-F20 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Florian "Ash" Rybilton was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F20 with the rations. Florian "Ash" Rybilton ate while listening to the revised orders.
Florian "Ash" Rybilton tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
The pump's fault proved to be a worn fitting. Florian "Ash" Rybilton made a replacement from scrap while the men returned to bailing by hand.
Florian "Ash" Rybilton and Arno Pars spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.

A bullet hit Florian "Ash" Rybilton in the neck at P-F20. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Tobias Countdooku of the Hegemony (@countdooku04). Florian "Ash" Rybilton reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up.
Florian "Ash" Rybilton is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
A medic stopped by Florian "Ash" Rybilton's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Florian "Ash" Rybilton had gone back to P-F20.
Florian's replacement fitting held, but the intake kept clogging. He fitted a rough screen and stayed through a full shift to watch it.
sgt.mohawk: The draft reached P-F22 on Day 11. Viktor Mohawk was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Felix Panzerfaust fell asleep on watch. Viktor Mohawk took over without waking Felix, and told the sergeant nothing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Mohawk. Viktor Mohawk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Felix Panzerfaust and Viktor Mohawk argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Mohawk. Viktor Mohawk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet went through Viktor Mohawk's upper arm at P-F22 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Mohawk. Viktor Mohawk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Viktor Mohawk lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
For days Viktor Mohawk was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.

Florian Irishman of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at Hill 304. Viktor Mohawk of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it. Mail came up the line with a letter for Viktor Mohawk. Viktor Mohawk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Viktor snores. Dietrich Hutchhll does not. Dietrich now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
taylormanme: On Day 14, Walter Taylormanme arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Walter Taylormanme of the Concord and Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Hugo Dewberrrryy and Walter Taylormanme tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Walter Taylormanme cut Gideon Zonkerz's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Walter had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Leopold Joshua was grazed.
travismac78: "You're late," said the corporal when Albin Travismac arrived on Day 3. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Albin Travismac saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards.

The salvo walked along S-F5 and caught Albin Travismac in the open. Two men carried him back between salvos. A letter from home reached Albin Travismac before dusk. Albin Travismac read it twice and slept a little easier.

No bed for Albin Travismac yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Albin Travismac during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
There was never a bed for Albin Travismac, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F5 on his own feet.
Albin Travismac and Oskar Mitaylor split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Albin Travismac fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Roland Maccerny was grazed. Albin Travismac ate breakfast without a word.
A bullet hit Albin Travismac's belt buckle at S-F5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Emil Majormalprac of the Concord (@majormalpractice_626).

The medics cleaned Albin Travismac's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F5. Blackwater Canal has been won. Albin Travismac listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Albin Travismac traded a tin whistle for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Albin Travismac is number 208. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Albin Travismac let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Albin Travismac spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
Albin Travismac found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: two small boys on a bench, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Albin Travismac was hit in the foot through his boot at S-F5. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one.
Albin Travismac lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.

The stretcher Albin Travismac lay on for so long has a dent the shape of a body. Albin Travismac is back at S-F5, and someone else is lying in that dent now. There was a letter for Albin Travismac. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Albin Travismac laughed for the first time in days.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Valentin Egilhermanss, grazed. Albin Travismac cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.

The whole squad at S-F5 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Albin's bullet that found Casimir Ojmcfall, badly wounded. Another letter for Albin today. The sergeant said Albin was the most popular man in the company. Albin said it was only because of the stamps.
